scene_description: You look more carefully at the writing desk. Several things catch your eye.

observations.text: The main drawer has been forced open — the wood around the lock is splintered clean. Someone used a letter opener or thin blade.
observations.journal_text: The desk drawer was forced with a blade. Whatever was kept there, someone needed it urgently.

observations.text: A half-burned document curls in the ash tray. Only fragments survive: '...transfer of...' and what looks like a sum of money.
observations.journal_text: Someone burned a document before leaving — it referenced a financial transfer. The rest is ash.

observations.text: The ink on the blotter is still wet, pressed into it backwards. With effort you can read a partial mirror image: '...do not trust H...'
observations.journal_text: The blotter carries a fresh ink impression: '...do not trust H...' Written within the last few hours. H — Harlow?
